sections.title: The letter te
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (тэ) /tɛ/. Its main sound is the sound /t/, that is a hard t, heard in the word (стол) /stol/, which means table. This letter can make three different sounds.

sections.title: How to make the sounds
paragraphs: Press the tip of your tongue against the back of your upper teeth. Release the breath sharply without voicing. For the soft sound, arch the middle of your tongue toward the roof of your mouth. For the voiced sound, keep the tongue in the first position and vibrate your vocal cords. Place a hand on your throat to feel the vibration.

sections.title: Reading this letter
paragraphs: This letter makes the sound /t/, that is a hard t, at the end of words or before most consonants, as in (там) /tam/. It makes the sound /tʲ/, that is a soft t, before soft vowels or a soft sign, as in (тётя) /ˈtʲɵ.tʲə/ and (мать) /matʲ/. Before voiced consonants, it makes the sound /d/, as in (отдых) /ˈod.dɨx/ and (футбол) /fudˈbol/.

sections.title: Avoiding mistakes
paragraphs: Do not puff air when you say this letter. English words like top release a puff of breath. Keep the release clean and tight. Also place your tongue against your teeth, not further back on the gum ridge.
